observation: Splitting one statement in src/AgentLoopVerifier.php shifted four baselined slop-scan findings down one line, and composer review:slop reported them as 4 new findings.

evidence.summary: Regenerated baseline diff: findingCount 10 before and after, configHash unchanged, only lines 283/365/485/439 moved to 284/366/486/440.

hypothesis: slop-scan fingerprints include the line number, so a pure formatting change reads as new slop.
validated_conclusion: A slop-scan baseline pinned to line numbers fails on formatting-only changes; re-pinning is correct only after diffing that just the locations changed.
